title: "DemocracyVsCorruption"
author: "Jacob De Fonseka"

output: html_document
---

```{r}

# ============================================================
# INSTITUTIONS GRAPH: DEMOCRACY VS CORRUPTION
# DATA 101 CAPSTONE PROJECT
# Interactive Scatterplot using Shiny, ggplot2, and Plotly
# Data Source: V-Dem (via wdi_clean.csv)
# ============================================================


# PART 1: LOAD PACKAGES

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)


# PART 2: IMPORT DATASET

# Search for wdi_clean.csv in the project folder.
# Also supports wdi_clean(1).csv.

files <- list.files(
  path = ".",
  pattern = "^wdi_clean(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {

  files <- list.files(
    path = "~",
    pattern = "^wdi_clean(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

}

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot find wdi_clean.csv. Check your Files tab.")
}

# Prefer the original wdi_clean.csv when available.

preferred <- files[
  basename(files) == "wdi_clean.csv"
]

data_path <- if (length(preferred) > 0) {
  preferred[1]
} else {
  files[1]
}

data <- read_csv(
  data_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# PART 3: CLEAN AND PREPARE DATA

graph_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    democracy = as.numeric(democracy),
    corruption = as.numeric(corruption),
    country = as.character(country),
    region = as.character(region),
    iso3c = as.character(iso3c)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(country),
    !is.na(region),
    !is.na(iso3c),
    is.finite(democracy),
    is.finite(corruption),
    democracy >= 0,
    democracy <= 1,
    corruption >= 0,
    corruption <= 1
  ) %>%
  distinct(iso3c, year, .keep_all = TRUE)


# PART 4: DEFAULT SETTINGS

available_years <- sort(unique(graph_data$year))

default_year <- if (2022 %in% available_years) {
  2022
} else {
  max(available_years)
}

region_choices <- sort(unique(graph_data$region))


# ============================================================
# PART 5: USER INTERFACE
# ============================================================

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel(
    "Democratic Institutions and Political Corruption"
  ),

  p(
    "Explore the relationship between democracy and
     political corruption across countries and years."
  ),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      # YEAR SLIDER

      sliderInput(
        inputId = "year",
        label = "Select Year:",
        min = min(available_years),
        max = max(available_years),
        value = default_year,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      # REGION FILTER

      selectInput(
        inputId = "region",
        label = "Select Region:",
        choices = c(
          "All Regions",
          region_choices
        ),
        selected = "All Regions"
      ),

      # DEMOCRACY RANGE

      sliderInput(
        inputId = "democracy_range",
        label = "Democracy Index Range:",
        min = 0,
        max = 1,
        value = c(0, 1),
        step = 0.05
      ),

      # CORRUPTION RANGE

      sliderInput(
        inputId = "corruption_range",
        label = "Corruption Index Range:",
        min = 0,
        max = 1,
        value = c(0, 1),
        step = 0.05
      ),

      # REGRESSION LINE

      checkboxInput(
        inputId = "show_trend",
        label = "Show Regression Line",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      # COLOR BY REGION

      checkboxInput(
        inputId = "color_region",
        label = "Color Countries by Region",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      # RESET BUTTON

      actionButton(
        inputId = "reset",
        label = "Reset Filters"
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Understanding the Variables"),

      p(
        strong("Democracy Index:"),
        "Higher scores indicate stronger democracy."
      ),

      p(
        strong("Political Corruption Index:"),
        "Higher scores indicate greater political corruption."
      ),

      p(
        "Both indices range from 0 to 1."
      ),

      hr(),

      p("Data Source: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem)")
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput(
        outputId = "democracy_scatter",
        height = "580px"
      ),

      h4("Summary Statistics"),

      fluidRow(

        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("country_count"))
        ),

        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("correlation"))
        ),

        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("average_corruption"))
        )

      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Country Data"),

      tableOutput("country_table"),

      br(),

      p(
        "Note: Correlation does not establish causation."
      )
    )
  )
)


# ============================================================
# PART 6: SERVER
# ============================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {


  # PART 6A: FILTER DATA

  filtered_data <- reactive({

    df <- graph_data %>%
      filter(
        year == input$year,
        democracy >= input$democracy_range[1],
        democracy <= input$democracy_range[2],
        corruption >= input$corruption_range[1],
        corruption <= input$corruption_range[2]
      )

    if (input$region != "All Regions") {

      df <- df %>%
        filter(region == input$region)

    }

    df
  })


  # PART 6B: CREATE INTERACTIVE SCATTERPLOT

  output$democracy_scatter <- renderPlotly({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 2,
        "Not enough countries for this selection."
      )
    )

    # Create country-specific hover labels

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        Hover = paste0(
          "<b>", country, "</b>",
          "<br>Year: ", year,
          "<br>Region: ", region,
          "<br>Democracy Index: ",
          round(democracy, 3),
          "<br>Corruption Index: ",
          round(corruption, 3)
        )
      )

    # Build scatterplot using ggplot2

    if (input$color_region) {

      p <- ggplot(
        df,
        aes(
          x = democracy,
          y = corruption,
          color = region,
          text = Hover
        )
      )

    } else {

      p <- ggplot(
        df,
        aes(
          x = democracy,
          y = corruption,
          text = Hover
        )
      )

    }

    # Add country points

    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        size = 2.8,
        alpha = 0.8
      )

    # Add regression line if selected

    if (input$show_trend && nrow(df) >= 3 &&
        sd(df$democracy) > 0) {

      p <- p +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 1,
          inherit.aes = TRUE
        )

    }

    # Format graph

    p <- p +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Democracy vs. Corruption:",
          input$year
        ),

        subtitle = paste(
          n_distinct(df$iso3c),
          "countries"
        ),

        x = "Democracy Index (0 = Low, 1 = High)",

        y = "Political Corruption Index (0 = Low, 1 = High)",

        color = "Region",

        caption = "Source: V-Dem"
      ) +

      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(0, 1),
        ylim = c(0, 1)
      ) +

      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 17
        ),

        plot.subtitle = element_text(
          color = "gray40"
        ),

        legend.position = "right",

        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )

    # Convert ggplot2 to interactive Plotly

    ggplotly(
      p,
      tooltip = "text"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        hovermode = "closest",

        margin = list(
          t = 90,
          b = 90,
          l = 85,
          r = 40
        )
      )

  })


  # PART 6C: COUNTRY COUNT

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Countries:",
      n_distinct(filtered_data()$iso3c)
    )

  })


  # PART 6D: PEARSON CORRELATION

  output$correlation <- renderText({

    df <- filtered_data()

    if (
      nrow(df) < 3 ||
      sd(df$democracy) == 0 ||
      sd(df$corruption) == 0
    ) {
      return("Pearson r: N/A")
    }

    r <- cor(
      df$democracy,
      df$corruption,
      use = "complete.obs",
      method = "pearson"
    )

    paste(
      "Pearson r:",
      round(r, 3)
    )

  })


  # PART 6E: AVERAGE CORRUPTION

  output$average_corruption <- renderText({

    df <- filtered_data()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return("Average corruption: N/A")
    }

    paste(
      "Avg. Corruption:",
      round(mean(df$corruption), 3)
    )

  })


  # PART 6F: COUNTRY DATA TABLE

  output$country_table <- renderTable({

    filtered_data() %>%
      arrange(desc(democracy)) %>%
      transmute(
        Country = country,
        Region = region,
        Democracy = round(democracy, 3),
        Corruption = round(corruption, 3)
      )

  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 7: RESET FILTERS
  # ==========================================================

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = default_year
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "region",
      selected = "All Regions"
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "democracy_range",
      value = c(0, 1)
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "corruption_range",
      value = c(0, 1)
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "show_trend",
      value = TRUE
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "color_region",
      value = TRUE
    )

  })

}


# ============================================================
# PART 8: RUN SHINY APP
# ============================================================

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)

```
